components.name: Large metal 4WD chassis, green

components.name: LEGO Mindstorms NXT 8527 Touch Sensor on the Tri-bot's front attachment
components.description: The NXT Touch Sensor on the attachment the Tri-bot's instructions build at its front, which goes on the Tri-bot (lego_8527_tribot_chassis) at its front seat: its button forward, behind a paddle, an axle 6 hung from an angle connector that pivots on a long pin, with a 12-tooth bevel gear on it in front of the button and an axle 7 across its foot; something in the robot's way swings the paddle back, and the gear presses the button. It tells whether its button is pressed. The two claws, which the Tri-bot's third motor opens and closes on axles of their own, are left out, and so are the gears that turn them. The ultrasonic sensor (lego_8527_ultrasonic_sensor) sits on an axle 7 across the attachment's top, at its sonar connector.
components.product: LEGO Mindstorms NXT 8527

components.name: LEGO Mindstorms NXT 8527 Ultrasonic Sensor on the Tri-bot's touch sensor attachment
components.description: The NXT Ultrasonic Sensor where the Tri-bot's instructions put it: on the axle 7 across the top of the touch sensor attachment (lego_8527_touch_sensor, at its sonar connector), through its lower lug, high at the front, looking forward. It measures the distance to the nearest object in front of it with sound.

Ackermann chassis(ref = "hiwonder_ackermann_chassis")

scope.core:
// Shown Pi 5 has a real mounting chain; motor control, power regulation and electrical/data connections remain unresolved.
// Mechanical candidate; actual mounting interfaces are declared below.
Robot mount_ackermann_a2_mapping {
    intent "Raised planar mapping with A2"

    Ackermann chassis(ref = "hiwonder_ackermann_chassis")
    Motor motor_left(ref = "hiwonder_520_gearmotor_90_12v", glue = (-0.08607209, 0.06030475, 0.01400358, 0, 1, 0))
    Motor motor_right(ref = "hiwonder_520_gearmotor_90_12v", glue = (-0.08607209, -0.06026475, 0.01400358, 0, -1, 0))
    Standard wheel_front_left(ref = "hiwonder_ackermann_chassis_wheel", glue = (0.0856, 0.0845, 0.014, 0, 1, 0))

installations.title: Hiwonder front Compact Arm capture dock
purposes: stock Compact Arm base capture candidate
two-arm robot with independent front and rear work areas
installations.description: A front-specific open aluminium frame locates four stock feet and uses removable toe clamps over the original baseplate, with backing strips below the actual chassis hole pattern.
limits: Core checks the declared base-plate capture and retaining chain through the dock to the chassis. Clamp preload, loads, physical fit and rotational or moving-arm clearance remain unqualified.

The host hole centers come from a coarse pinned JetAuto maker mesh associated with the green retail chassis. Purchased-kit fit, hole tolerances and material properties require physical or native-CAD confirmation.
The front dock uses M3 and the rear dock M2.5 host throughbolts with underside backing strips. These sizes are geometric candidates, not a qualified arm load rating.
Native geometry checks cover the displayed upright pose. Arm sweeps, reach under load, clamp preload, chassis bending, fatigue and stability under motion remain unverified.
The Pi carrier provides a computer location, not motor/servo control, a battery, power regulation, complete wiring or thermal qualification.
Core's conservative collision findings and unknowns are preserved. Selecting this installation does not establish a powered working robot.

installations.title: Hiwonder rear Compact Arm capture dock
purposes: stock Compact Arm base capture candidate
two-arm robot with independent front and rear work areas
installations.description: A rear-specific open aluminium frame locates four stock feet and uses removable toe clamps over the original baseplate, with backing strips below the actual chassis hole pattern.
limits: Core checks the declared base-plate capture and retaining chain through the dock to the chassis. Clamp preload, loads, physical fit and rotational or moving-arm clearance remain unqualified.

The host hole centers come from a coarse pinned JetAuto maker mesh associated with the green retail chassis. Purchased-kit fit, hole tolerances and material properties require physical or native-CAD confirmation.
The front dock uses M3 and the rear dock M2.5 host throughbolts with underside backing strips. These sizes are geometric candidates, not a qualified arm load rating.
Native geometry checks cover the displayed upright pose. Arm sweeps, reach under load, clamp preload, chassis bending, fatigue and stability under motion remain unverified.
The Pi carrier provides a computer location, not motor/servo control, a battery, power regulation, complete wiring or thermal qualification.
Core's conservative collision findings and unknowns are preserved. Selecting this installation does not establish a powered working robot.

installations.title: LEGO 42109 covered side IMU case
installations.description: Covered board on two native left-sill pin holes. Two M2 screws share PCB and lid clamping; the original running gear and source battery removal path are retained.
limits: Nominal source geometry only. Printed fit, pin mould variant, friction, pull-out force, wear and vibration transfer require physical qualification. Two pins constrain nominal yaw but do not prove measurement accuracy.
Case floor is chassis (-39.16,63,43.5) mm and PCB origin is (-39.16,63,50.2) mm, below the native roof. It is a low side location, not at ground level.
Native battery lid and holder were screened through 18 removal poses against the added fixture. This does not certify stock assembly service procedures, hands or cable routing.

The main header has a measured access opening; no specific header, cable, strain relief, reading computer, power or electrical connection is integrated. Auxiliary header use requires another fit check.
SLS PA12 manufacturing candidate, not an unsupported FDM-ready or weather-sealed case. See final STL measurements and purchased hardware in the fabrication instructions.

unresolved.imu_case: Measured host placement only: Core has no retaining rule for this purchased friction-pin receiver relationship.

The rear-left Pi5 has its existing carrier. Power regulation, motor/servo control and data links remain incomplete.

limits: Manufacturing candidate only; physical fit, strength, vibration, sensing and commissioning are untested.
The kit includes control boards absent from its CAD; actual board and wiring access must be checked. No electrical or autonomous-stop integration is supplied.
Downward ToF observes one narrow region ahead of the right-front support, not complete cliff coverage.
installations.snippet:
Diff_drive chassis(ref = "yahboom_alloy_chassis_4wd")
Mount sonar_support(ref = "robotdsl_yahboom_alloy_sonar_cradle", on = @core/chassis, at = "alloy_front_sonar", by = "under_holes")
Ultrasonic sonar(ref = "maxbotix_mb1010_lv_maxsonar_ez1", on = @core/sonar_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "mounting_holes")

scope.core:
// Yahboom's aluminium alloy chassis as its four-wheel drive kit builds it: the two plates with the four motors under
// the lower one, on the kit's four rubber wheels, all driven.
Robot yahboom_alloy_4wd_front_sensing {
    intent "Yahboom aluminium alloy chassis kit, four-wheel skid-steer drive"

    Diff_drive chassis(ref = "yahboom_alloy_chassis_4wd")

    // The kit's motors, each on its bracket at a wheel.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "yahboom_l_type_520_encoder_motor", glue = (0.049698527324, 0.0304, -0.0686571542, 0, 1, 0))
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "yahboom_l_type_520_encoder_motor", glue = (0.0497, -0.0304, -0.06867, 0, -1, 0))
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "yahboom_l_type_520_encoder_motor", glue = (-0.0497, 0.0304, -0.06867, 0, 1, 0))
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "yahboom_l_type_520_encoder_motor", glue = (-0.0497, -0.0304, -0.06867, 0, -1, 0))

    Standard wheel_front_left(ref = "yahboom_alloy_chassis_4wd_wheel", glue = (0.0497, 0.06015, -0.0687, 0, 1, 0))
    Standard wheel_front_right(ref = "yahboom_alloy_chassis_4wd_wheel", glue = (0.0497, -0.06015, -0.0687, 0, -1, 0))
    Standard wheel_rear_left(ref = "yahboom_alloy_chassis_4wd_wheel", glue = (-0.0497, 0.06015, -0.0687, 0, 1, 0))
    Standard wheel_rear_right(ref = "yahboom_alloy_chassis_4wd_wheel", glue = (-0.0497, -0.06015, -0.0687, 0, -1, 0))
    Mount sonar_support(ref = "robotdsl_yahboom_alloy_sonar_cradle", on = @core/chassis, at = "alloy_front_sonar", by = "under_holes")
    Ultrasonic sonar(ref = "maxbotix_mb1010_lv_maxsonar_ez1", on = @core/sonar_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "mounting_holes")
    Mount cliff_support(ref = "robotdsl_yahboom_alloy_cliff_outrigger", on = @core/chassis, at = "alloy_right_cliff", by = "under_holes")
    Range cliff(ref = "pololu_vl53l4cd_carrier", on = @core/cliff_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "mounting_holes")
}
